result:
If I could make one change, it would be to dramatically expand human empathy—specifically, our ability to genuinely feel the weight of other people's experiences, even when they live across the world, hold different beliefs, or haven't been born yet.

Many of the biggest crises facing the world today—extreme poverty, violent conflict, climate change, and deep polarization—aren't purely technical problems. Humanity already possesses the ingenuity, technology, and resources to solve most of them. What is often missing is the collective will to act on behalf of people outside our immediate circles. 

If people naturally felt a deeper connection to strangers and future generations, it would act as a multiplier for almost every other positive change. Cooperation would become easier, cruelty would become much harder to justify, and long-term stewardship of the planet would feel as urgent as protecting one's own home.

What about you? If you had that power, what is the one thing you would change?
